items.author: Trump
items.text: When I announced that I was running in the 2024 Presidential Election, right at the beginning, Ford was getting ready to close their Big Factory, in Detroit. Then, because I was leading in the Polls, they figured they would leave it open a little longer to see what happened. Now it’s running 24/7, and it’s one of the most profitable Car Plants in the World! There are many other examples, for both Ford, General Motors, and others. items.text: RT @sergiogorPresident Trump is the Greatest JOBS President in American History. items.text: Elon Musk Owns 48.4% of SpaceX, a New Filing Shows. Here's Why That Matters for Everyone Else Holding the Stock.

items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk’s faster path to more gas turbines comes with pollution problem
items.summary_cn: Musk为加速AI算力部署大量上马燃气轮机，但带来污染争议，对电力/能源设备板块（含SK海力士所在的半导体电力需求链）有间接影响。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Congratulations to NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman, and the Great Patriots at NASA, on a successful launch. This is THE GOLDEN AGE OF AMERICA! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普祝贺NASA及局长Isaacman成功发射，航天板块情绪利好，软关联到kcn持有的SpaceX相关标的。

items.author: Musk
items.text: OpenAI to end model access to Cursor after acquisition by Elon Musk's SpaceX
items.summary_cn: 报道称OpenAI将在Musk旗下SpaceX收购Cursor后切断其模型访问，间接凸显SpaceX跨界AI布局，软关联到kcn持有的SpaceX标的。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Trump’s historic oil deal with Venezuela realigns global energy and puts OPEC, Canada on notice: https://justthenews.com/government/white-house/trump-announces-massive-oil-deal-venezuela
items.summary_cn: 特朗普与委内瑞拉达成'史上最大'石油协议，被解读为重塑全球能源格局、对OPEC和加拿大发出警告。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Let all Canadian Companies that are doing business with America move to the United States, immediately. Many of them are Companies that moved out years ago due to stupid U.S. Leadership. When you move back, there are no TARIFFS! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普喊话加拿大企业迁回美国，承诺无关税，意在重振美国制造业与汽车产业。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Canadian businesses are pouring into the United States. We want to make our own cars, etc. That’s what’s going to happen. Canada has been ripping us off for years — NO LONGER! President DJT
items.summary_cn: 特朗普宣称加拿大企业正涌入美国，要在美国造车，强化对加关税与制造业回流叙事。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Our deal with Venezuela is the biggest oil deal, by far, in World history! President DJT
items.summary_cn: 特朗普宣称美委石油协议是'世界史上最大'，提振美国能源供给预期。

items.author: Trump
items.text: One of the things I am going to do with the Venezuelan Oil is fill up the Strategic National Reserves which, because of Sleepy Joe Biden, has been virtually emptied. The “topping out” process will begin very shortly, and is a Gift from Venezuela to the People of the United States. Thank you! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称将用委内瑞拉石油补充已近枯竭的美国战略石油储备。

items.summary_cn: OpenAI切断对Cursor的AI模型供应，Musk与OpenAI矛盾进一步深化，AI行业竞争叙事升温。

items.summary_cn: OpenAI以'不信任Musk'为由终止与Cursor合作，与第14、16条同事件，不重复返回。
